findings.description: The detector accepts any account window of at least one day and ignores shorter-window use. Executed probe cycles with fresh 0% 1440-minute/reset+1-day and 20160-minute/reset+14-day readings each ran a touch despite having no weekly evidence. A fresh seven_day=0% plus five_hour=1% also ran a touch, violating the requested nonzero-use exclusion.

An unforced touch rechecks eligibility and touch spacing after reserving, but never checks work that began after planning. Executed a not-started plan, then inserted a successful Luna job that opened the clock and finished before _claim acquired the lane. The operator pass still ran another touch because the completed attempt was absent from the busy check.

The implicit Luna default resolves through retired aliases. Executed load_policy on a valid policy without models.luna or timers.touch_model and with retired.luna=astra; touch_model returned gpt-6-astra at ultra effort instead of the promised gpt-6-luna fallback. The explicit retired-alias validation does not run when the setting is absent.
